domain_claim: compute_action_idempotency_key(run, seq, action) is deterministic: same inputs always produce same u128 output. No time, randomness, or external state influences the result.
model_boundary: vb_core action.rs:compute_action_idempotency_key — pure function from (RunId, SeqNo, ActionId) to u128. No I/O, no mutable state, no randomness.
notes: Key collision is possible (H1) due to wrapping arithmetic on 160-bit input mapped to 128-bit output. Tracker independence from key provides defense-in-depth.

domain_claim: ActionReplayTracker keys on (ActionId, StepIdx) only, NOT idempotency_key. Two tickets with same (action, step) but different attempt or idempotency_key are treated as potential divergence if evidence differs.
model_boundary: vb_storage/recovery/types.rs:ActionReplayTracker. mark_scheduled_ticket_effect and mark_completed_envelope_effect only inspect (action, step) for lookup; full ticket evidence is compared for divergence detection.
notes: Tracker key independence from idempotency_key is intentional design. Caller confusion about this boundary is a hazard (H10).

domain_claim: validate_idempotency_key_ingredients MUST be called before issuing any KeyRequired action ticket. Key slots must NOT contain Taint::Secret, Taint::DerivedFromSecret, Taint::Random, or Taint::TimeDependent.
model_boundary: vb_core/action.rs:validate_idempotency_key_ingredients. Pure function reading RunFrame slot taint. Called by verify_idempotency before ticket issuance.
notes: H5 (secret leak) and H6 (random/time-dependent key) are blocked by this contract. Flux refinement types could enforce this at the type level.

domain_claim: hydrate_run_frame is atomic: either returns Ok(RunFrame) with all state correctly reconstructed OR returns typed RecoveryError with no side effects. No partial state on error.
model_boundary: vb_storage/recovery/hydrate.rs:hydrate_run_frame. All state modifications happen inside the function. No cleanup required on error path because no external side effects.
notes: RecoveryError variants are all typed. No String errors. Atomicity is enforced by the function structure, not by a transaction system.

domain_claim: ActionCompletedEnvelope.value_digest is the BLAKE3 digest of the value bytes. Any mismatch in digest between two envelopes for the same (action, step) indicates divergence or corruption.
model_boundary: vb_storage/src/events.rs:ActionCompletedEnvelope.value_digest field. mark_completed_envelope_effect compares digests. BLAKE3 is used for its collision resistance.
notes: H4 (value digest mismatch) is caught by mark_completed_envelope_effect returning ReplayDivergence. Digest comparison is exact, not probabilistic.

domain_claim: For any run, all JournalEvent sequence numbers must be strictly monotonically increasing. No two events share the same (run_id, seq). Tail events with seq <= snapshot.seq are rejected as stale.
model_boundary: vb_storage/recovery/hydrate.rs:hydrate_snapshot_tail_seq_after_snapshot. Pure boolean check on event sequence numbers. apply_tail_events iterates in seq order.
notes: H7 (stale event hazard) is blocked by hydrate_snapshot_tail_seq_after_snapshot preconditions check before any processing.

domain_claim: ActionReplayTracker MUST block replay of RetrySafety::Unsafe actions. mark_scheduled_ticket_effect returns Err(NonIdempotentActionBlocked) if is_resolved(action, step) is true.
model_boundary: vb_storage/recovery/types.rs:ActionReplayTracker::mark_scheduled_ticket_effect. is_resolved check is applied BEFORE duplicate detection. is_resolved returns true if completed.contains(key) or failed.contains(key).
notes: H3 (replay attack) is blocked by this contract. Non-idempotent actions that completed before crash cannot be re-executed during recovery.

domain_claim: ActionReplayTracker identity key is (ActionId, StepIdx). Two ActionScheduledTicket events with same (action, step) but different ActionTicket evidence (different seq, attempt, idempotency_key, capacity) produce ReplayDivergence, not Duplicate.
model_boundary: vb_storage/recovery/types.rs:mark_scheduled_ticket_effect. Compares full ActionScheduleEvidence { ticket, input, output } for equality. HashMap lookup key is (action, step), but evidence comparison is by full struct equality.
notes: H2 (divergent tickets) is caught by evidence comparison. The HashMap lookup key is (action, step), but the actual evidence must also match for Duplicate.

domain_claim: No ActionTicket with RetrySafety::KeyRequired may have idempotency_key derived from slots containing Taint::Secret, Taint::DerivedFromSecret, Taint::Random, or Taint::TimeDependent. validate_idempotency_key_ingredients enforces this before ticket issuance.
model_boundary: vb_core/action.rs:validate_idempotency_key_ingredients. Reads slot taint from RunFrame for each SlotIdx in key_slots. Returns IdempotencyViolation on taint violation.
notes: Combined with H5 and H6. This is a pre-condition for issuing KeyRequired tickets. The check is at the vb_core boundary, enforced by vb_storage before calling issue_action_ticket.

domain_claim: hydrate_snapshot_tail_preconditions returns true iff: (1) snapshot.run == run_id and all tail events have run_id == run_id, (2) all tail events have seq > snapshot.seq, (3) at least one of tail_events non-empty, snapshot.slots non-empty, or snapshot.taint non-empty.
model_boundary: vb_storage/recovery/hydrate.rs:hydrate_snapshot_tail_preconditions. Three boolean sub-checks combined with &&. Delegates to run_matches, seq_after_snapshot, has_evidence.
notes: Enforces H7 (stale events) and run ID consistency. Prevents NoRecoveryData with no actual data.

domain_claim: hydrate_events_preconditions returns true iff !events.is_empty(). Empty events slice always returns false.
model_boundary: vb_storage/recovery/hydrate.rs:hydrate_events_preconditions. const fn, no runtime computation beyond is_empty check.
notes: Simple non-empty check for events-only hydration path.

domain_claim: action_ticket_has_valid_key(ticket) returns true iff ticket.idempotency_key equals compute_action_idempotency_key(ticket.run, ticket.seq, ticket.action). Returns false otherwise.
model_boundary: vb_core/action.rs:action_ticket_has_valid_key. Pure comparison of ticket.idempotency_key against computed canonical key.
notes: Used in verify_action_ticket_event to validate ticket key is canonical before allowing hydration to proceed.

domain_claim: apply_tail_events processes JournalEvents in strictly increasing seq order. Events with seq <= processed seq are skipped or produce error. No out-of-order processing.
model_boundary: vb_storage/recovery/hydrate_support.rs:apply_tail_events. Iterates over tail_events in order, updates tracker and frame for each event. Skips events with stale seq (pre-snapshot).
notes: GI4 enforced by iteration order. No parallel processing of events out of seq order.

domain_claim: mark_completed_envelope_effect returns Err(ReplayDivergence) when an existing completed_envelopes entry for (action, step) has evidence that differs from the new envelope evidence. The check is: existing != new_evidence.
model_boundary: vb_storage/recovery/types.rs:ActionReplayTracker::mark_completed_envelope_effect. Full ActionCompletionEvidence comparison includes ticket, output, encoded_len, taint, value_digest.
notes: H4 captured here. Any difference in envelope evidence produces divergence error, not Duplicate.

domain_claim: mark_completed_envelope_effect returns Ok(Duplicate) if completed.contains(key) or failed.contains(key), even if no completed_envelopes entry exists. Already-resolved actions are not re-inserted into completed_envelopes.
model_boundary: vb_storage/recovery/types.rs:ActionReplayTracker::mark_completed_envelope_effect. The early-return for completed/failed checks comes AFTER the HashMap lookup but BEFORE any insertion.
notes: Allows idempotent completion envelopes for already-resolved actions without storing duplicate envelope evidence.

domain_claim: hydrate_dimensions_positive(step_count, slot_count) returns true iff step_count > 0 AND slot_count > 0. Dimensions that underflow to 0 or overflow u16 are rejected by downstream checks.
model_boundary: vb_storage/recovery/hydrate.rs:hydrate_dimensions_positive. const fn, pure comparison. derive_dimensions_from_snapshot_and_tail computes dimensions, this function validates positivity.
notes: H9 captured here. Zero dimensions rejected immediately. Overflow to u16 handled by FrameDimensionOverflow error.

domain_claim: verify_idempotency returns Err(MissingKey(SideEffect)) when RetrySafety::KeyRequired and key_slots.is_empty(), OR when RetrySafety::Unsafe. SideEffect carried in error variant is the action's declared side_effect.
model_boundary: vb_core/action.rs:verify_idempotency. Matches on RetrySafety variant. For KeyRequired with empty key_slots, returns MissingKey with the action's side_effect field.
notes: Enforces AC3 at the contract level. MissingKey error carries the SideEffect classification for diagnostics.

domain_claim: is_resolved returns true if completed.contains(&(action, step)) OR failed.contains(&(action, step)). Returns false if neither. is_resolved is called BEFORE duplicate detection in mark_scheduled_ticket_effect.
model_boundary: vb_storage/recovery/types.rs:ActionReplayTracker::is_resolved (private method). Simple HashSet lookup. mark_scheduled_ticket_effect calls this first to block already-resolved actions.
notes: AC1 captured here. is_resolved prevents NonIdempotentActionBlocked from ever reaching Duplicate path.

domain_claim: vb_core contains NO references to vb_storage types. vb_storage imports vb_core::ActionTicket but vb_core does not import from vb_storage. The core is pure and side-effect free.
model_boundary: vb_core (crates/vb_core) has no dependencies on vb_storage. vb_storage (crates/vb_storage) depends on vb_core.
notes: Boundary enforced by cargo dependency graph. rustc --edition transitive deps check could verify. No circular dependency possible by construction.

domain_claim: require_scheduled_ticket returns Ok(()) if a scheduled_tickets entry exists for (action, step) AND existing.ticket == ticket AND existing.output == output. Returns Err(ReplayDivergence) otherwise.
model_boundary: vb_storage/recovery/types.rs:ActionReplayTracker::require_scheduled_ticket. Called by apply_tail_events when processing ActionCompletedEnvelope to ensure schedule exists before accepting completion.
notes: Envelope without schedule is ReplayDivergence, not silently accepted. Ensures completions are only accepted for properly scheduled actions.
